title: Russian central bank holds key rate steady ahead of election
summary: In a recent decision, Russia's central bank opted to hold the benchmark interest rate at fourteen percent. Economic challenges have intensified due to heightened price pressures. Positive news came from a reduction in the budget deficit, supported by dividend influxes and soaring oil prices.
